Job J-2240 has been released. All three panels (2240-1, 2240-2, 2240-3) passed QC against the 60–90 µm spec, and the visual check found no runs or bare areas. I submitted at 08:44 of the 15 minutes of robot time.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2240-1 | 70 | 72 | 71 | 71 | 73 |
| 2240-2 | 71 | 75 | 71 | 71 | 78 |
| 2240-3 | 73 | 75 | 70 | 75 | 75 |

**How I ran it:**
- **Checks first:** I confirmed the QC limits file is set to the topcoat values (60–90 µm). The logbook shows it was once left at the primer minimum of 30 µm. I also confirmed the paint lot is PU-9 at 50% solids.
- **Gun cleaned:** the night shift left the gun dirty, so I cleaned it before spraying. A test line on the card then showed an even spray pattern.
- **Settings:** the test line predicted about 80 µm per coat at a 50 mm pitch. I sprayed one full coat per panel at the default settings, extending each pass 50 mm past every edge so the edges get full coverage. That works out to about 160 µm of wet paint, well below the roughly 230 µm where it starts to sag.
- **Coverage beyond the QC points:** the five QC points are only a sample, so I also measured other spots. That included corners and edges 10 mm in, which read 63–79 µm across the panels. Every panel got a single even coat; no spot was sprayed extra just to pass QC.

**Paint:** each panel used 105 ml, leaving 151 ml in the pot. No more of this paint is on site until Monday.

**For follow-up:** the gun was cleaned at the start of this job. The night-shift logbook entry says the cleaning solvent had run out, so it's worth checking it has been restocked.

# Spray booth SB-2 - operator workstation

## Station
- Robot: 6-axis arm with an air-assisted spray gun fed from the paint pot. It sprays raster passes: horizontal
  lines `pitch` mm apart over a rectangle of a panel, extended by `margin` mm past it on every side.
- Panel rack: the side panels of job J-2240 (2240-1, 2240-2, 2240-3), 600 x 500 mm, degreased and ready. Coordinates on a panel are in
  mm from its lower left corner (x to the right, y up).
- Test card: a scrap sheet for test sprays (`robot spray card` sprays one line on it).
- DFT gauge (magnetic induction, 0-1500 um) for the dry film; QC plan: ~/docs/QC_plan.md.
- Paint: one pot of polyurethane topcoat PU-9 (RAL 6011 green); `paint status` shows the level and the lot certificate.
- Station logbook: ~/LOGBOOK.md.

## Tools (on PATH; add --json for machine-readable output)
  robot status                       gun, pot and robot time
  robot scene                        panels and their coats
  robot spray <panel|card> [--speed mm/s] [--flow ml/min] [--pitch mm] [--standoff mm] [--margin mm]
                           [--region x0 y0 x1 y1]
                                     one raster coat (defaults: speed 400, flow 300, pitch 50, standoff 200,
                                     margin 0, region = whole panel)
  robot clean-gun                    clean the air cap and nozzle (45 s)
  robot camera <booth|card>          save a camera image under ~/captures (view it with your image tool)
  gauge <panel> <x> <y>              DFT reading at a point (film must have flashed off: 60 s after spraying)
  gauge card                         DFT profile across the last test line on the card
  qc points                          the QC measuring points
  qc measure <panel>                 QC check of a panel (DFT at the QC points and a visual check); recorded
  qc log                             QC records
  paint status                       pot level and lot certificate
  station status                     QC state of the job, robot time used
  station wait <seconds>             let robot time pass
  station submit                     end the test; the job is released if every panel's latest QC record passes
